title: Black-hole evaporation from the semiclassical Einstein equations in 3+1 dimensions
summary: We solve the semiclassical Einstein equations for an evaporating Schwarzschild black hole in closed form, obtaining its backreacted geometry in 3+1 dimensions. This is achieved by a reformulation of the Hadamard renormalization prescription, which admits explicit stress-energy tensors for scalar quantum fields in 3+1-dimensional curved spacetimes without the standard mode-sum construction. The Unruh-like states we construct reproduce the Hawking flux at future null infinity and the associated ingoing negative-energy flux at the horizon, yielding the first analytical quasi-stationary solution…
